title: Terminus-4B: Can a Smaller Model Replace Frontier LLMs at Agentic Execution Tasks?
abstract: arXiv:2605.03195v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern coding agents increasingly delegate specialized subtasks to subagents, which are smaller, focused agentic loops that handle narrow responsibilities like search, debugging or terminal execution. This architectural pattern keeps the main agent's context window clean by isolating verbose outputs (e.g. build logs, test results, etc.) within the subagent context. Typically when agents employ subagents for such tasks, they use frontier models as these subagents. In this paper, we investigate whether a finetuned small language model (SLM) can achieve comparable performance to frontier models in the task of agentic terminal execution. We present Terminus-4B, which is a post-trained Qwen3-4B model via Supervised Finetuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) using rubric-based LLM-as-judge reward, specifically for this task. In our extensive evaluation spanning various frontier models, training ablations and main agent configurations

translated_title: Terminus-4B：更小的模型能否在智能体执行任务中取代前沿大语言模型？
translated_abstract: 现代编程智能体越来越多地将专门的子任务委托给子智能体，这些子智能体是规模更小、更专注的智能体循环，负责处理诸如搜索、调试或终端执行等狭窄的职责。这种架构模式通过在子智能体的上下文中隔离冗长的输出（例如构建日志、测试结果等），来保持主智能体上下文窗口的整洁。通常，当智能体使用子智能体执行此类任务时，它们会采用前沿模型作为这些子智能体。在本文中，我们研究了经过微调的小型语言模型（SLM）能否在智能体终端执行任务中达到与前沿模型相当的性能。我们提出了 Terminus-4B，这是一个针对该任务、通过监督微调（SFT）以及采用基于量规的 LLM-as-judge 奖励的强化学习（RL）进行后训练的 Qwen3-4B 模型。在我们涵盖多种前沿模型、训练消融实验和主智能体配置的广泛评估中……
tldr: 本文提出 Terminus-4B——一个通过 SFT 和基于量规的 LLM-as-judge 强化学习后训练的 Qwen3-4B 模型，证明了经过针对性微调的小型语言模型可以在智能体终端执行任务中达到与前沿大模型相当的性能，从而可作为子智能体替代前沿模型。
en_tdlr: Terminus-4B, a Qwen3-4B model post-trained via SFT and rubric-based LLM-as-judge reinforcement learning, demonstrates that a fine-tuned small language model can achieve performance comparable to frontier LLMs in agentic terminal execution tasks, serving as a viable subagent replacement.
